messages:
Iris W: Quick heads-up  scheduling a 00:30 UTC rollout for feature flag `adaptive-batching` (model v3.4). Regional roll EU -> NA -> APAC, ramp 1% -> 20% -> 100%, soak 10m per step. Pin v2 for APAC until 20%. Runbook link: https://runbooks/redwood/adaptive-batching

Ben K: Circuit-breaker: if error_rate > 1.0% OR p95 > baseline + 150ms for 2 consecutive 5m windows, set region pct=0, pin to v2 and page #eng-oncall. Also exclude test traffic.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by Iris W at 2026-03-22T00:30:00Z. Canary eu-west-1 at 1%. Will post health checks.

QA: Exclude cohorts `internal_*` and `perf_*`. CLI runbook snippet:
```
/ff toggle adaptive-batching --region eu --pct 1 --exclude internal_* --exclude perf_*
/ff toggle adaptive-batching --region eu --pct 20
/ff toggle adaptive-batching --pct 0 --pin v2 --reason "rollback"
```

oncall-bot: Alerting configured: DM oncall + page if auto-rollback. Monitoring p95_latency, request_error_rate, 99th_token_latency.

Ben K: NA pacing: hold 25m at 20% (NA high qps). APAC: remain pinned until manual unpin after 30m at 20% and confirm KV cache warmups.

Iris W: Release notes for support/product: "adaptive-batching v3.4: phased regional rollout to reduce latency variance. Per-region v2 pin for APAC until stability gates pass. Auto-rollback and manual rollback playbooks in runbook."

deploy-bot: Canary EU healthy at 5m check. No spikes, proceeding per plan. :rocket: 

Ben K: Kicking NA canary to 1% in 2m, will pause if anything unusual.

(End of thread)
